messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text:
Hi Erkki, I'm at the site now. Changed the SFP on transmission node TRN-042.
Link is up and alarms cleared, but traffic is still not coming back. Have you seen this before?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Yes. Is this one of the older units?

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text:
Ok. Don't trust the green link status on those.
Sometimes after changing the SFP the interface comes up normally, but the forwarding state doesn't recover correctly.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text:
No. Usually the SFP is fine.
Check whether the traffic counters are actually increasing. If they stay at zero even though the interface is UP, it's probably the issue I've seen before.

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Yes. Link UP. RX power looks normal. Counters basically zero.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text:
That's it.
Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again. Don't reboot the whole unit unless that fails.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: Good. These old units sometimes behave like this after an optical module replacement.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text:
Not that I know of 😄
We've just learned it over the years.
